units.source_text: 此时一轮明月升上天空。

en.t: At this moment a bright full moon rose into the sky.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起今天是十五之夜，便有无穷往事涌上心头。

en.t: Prince Genji remembered that tonight was the fifteenth night, and countless memories came flooding into his heart.

units.source_text: 遥想清凉殿上，正在饮酒作乐，令人不胜艳羡；

en.t: Thinking far away to the Seiryoden, where people must now be drinking wine and making merry, he could not help envying them.

units.source_text: 南宫北馆，定有无数愁人，对月长叹。

en.t: In the southern palace and the northern mansions, there must surely be countless sorrowful people sighing at the moon.

units.source_text: 于是凝望月色，冥想京都种种情状。

en.t: So he gazed intently at the moonlight and brooded over all the scenes of the capital.

units.source_text: 继而朗吟“二千里外故人心”，闻者照例感动流泪。

en.t: Then he recited aloud, "The heart of an old friend two thousand li away," and as usual those who heard him were moved to tears.

units.source_text: 又讽诵以前藤壶皇后送他的诗：“重重夜雾遮明月……”

en.t: He also chanted the poem that Empress Fujitsubo had once sent him: "Layer upon layer of night mist hides the bright moon..."

units.source_text: 攒眉长叹，不胜恋恋之情。

en.t: He knit his brows and sighed deeply, unable to bear his lingering longing.

units.source_text: 历历回思往事，不禁嘤嘤地哭出声来。

en.t: As past events came vividly back to him, he could not help sobbing aloud.

units.source_text: 左右劝道：“夜深了，请公子安息去也。”

en.t: His attendants urged him, "The night is late. Please, my lord, go and rest."

units.source_text: 但公子还不肯返室，吟诗道：

en.t: But the prince still would not return to his room, and he recited a poem:
